Appearance

Late 30s, warm honey-toned skin, thick dark blonde curls pinned with a jeweled hair comb. Always impeccably dressed in fine gowns with tasteful, expensive jewelry.

What We Know

A wealthy jewelry connoisseur in the Rich District of Highreach. Known for her exquisite collection and strong opinions about craftsmanship.

First Impressions

Refined and particular — the kind of person who notices every detail and expects perfection.
